name: Dynamic Assist
description: Experimental predictive input assistance for standard game modes.

window.name: Maximum delay (ticks)
window.description: Maximum delay for an early input. Set to 0 for unmodified input.

diagnostics.name: Diagnostic log
diagnostics.description: Record why clicks were or were not adjusted in the local Geode log. Turn off after testing.

budget.name: Prediction time budget (ms)
budget.description: Maximum time spent searching per input. Higher values can cause frame drops; uncertain predictions pass through unchanged.

show-controls.name: Show in-level controls
show-controls.description: Show the assistance controls and statistics during a level.

horizon.name: Prediction lookahead (ticks)
horizon.description: Steps simulated after each candidate input, from 32 to 256. Longer lookahead costs more CPU and assumes no further clicks. It does not guarantee safety beyond the simulated world.
